SERAPH is an avant-garde digital couture piece designed to blur the boundary between sculpture and fashion. Inspired by celestial forms, organic structures, and architectural silhouettes, this garment combines dramatic volume with elegant craftsmanship.

Every element has been carefully developed inside CLO3D using premium digital construction techniques to achieve a highly detailed silhouette suitable for professional visualization.

The garment is ideal for:

title: Aethera – Futuristic Female Bodysuit
content:
## ![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/099fac71bfd74239b3a9a0c51a8427e2Final.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/7b9db4e9d7924e61a492549f309b7414Untitled-1.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/0abb38318b284ad8b03686065b24040b70c002b6-03ac-4011-93c7-0cb2f861c7e2.png)**Aethera – A Bodysuit Beyond Species**

Aethera was born from a simple design concept:

**To create a garment that could be worn by both humans and extraterrestrial beings.**

Rather than designing clothing for a single species, I explored the idea of a universal bodysuit that feels equally natural on humanoid lifeforms from different worlds. The silhouette combines asymmetrical armor elements with ribbed textile panels, balancing protection, flexibility, and mobility while maintaining a clean futuristic aesthetic.

The contrast between weathered metallic surfaces and soft fabrics emphasizes the coexistence of advanced technology and wearable comfort. Every panel was carefully shaped to create a design that could belong to a future where fashion is no longer limited to Earth.

The garment was created in **CLO3D / Marvelous Designer** and textured with **4K PBR materials** , making it suitable for digital fashion, game characters, cinematics, virtual production, and real-time rendering.
